desc: Ideation: compare approaches (memoized DFS, split-at-turn precompute, two-phase diagonal DP) and pitfalls.
Define the 4 diagonal direction vectors and confirm the clockwise 90-degree turn mapping down-right→down-left→up-left→up-right→down-right against examples.
Precompute forward alternating run lengths f[d][cell] = max valid sequence length starting at cell going d.
Implement backward DP g[d][cell] = max alternating run ending at cell arriving via d that starts at a value-1 cell.
Combine: max over no-turn runs (start value 1) and over apexes using g[d][apex] + f[(d+1)%4][apex] - 1.
Verified next-value lookup (1→2, 2→0, 0→2); all four samples produce 5, 4, 5, 1.
Confirmed O(nm) memory/time fits n,m ≤ 500; edge cases (no-1 → 0, immediate-turn V shapes) handled.
